title: Luxurious Earthy Spanish Shrimp Gambas Al Ajillo
description: A rich and earthy Spanish dish featuring shrimp, stilton cheese, and shio-koji cure, perfect for a post-workout meal, this low-glycemic friendly recipe is served in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the shio-koji cure, garlic, smoked paprika, and salt.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the cure mixture.
Cut the banana leaves into large squares and brush with olive oil.
Place a shrimp on each banana leaf square and top with a spoonful of stilton cheese.
Fold the banana leaves over the shrimp to form a packet and secure with a toothpick.
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with additional stilton cheese and smoked paprika if desired.
